DISASSEMBLY OF OVERDRIVE INPUT SHAFT AND CLUTCH

1. REMOVE THRUST BEARINGS AND RACES FROM OVERDRIVE INPUT SHAFT

(a) Slide off the thrust bearing and race from the clutch side by hand. Note the position of the races.

(b) Using a screwdriver, pry off the thrust washer from the planetary gear side.

AT0851

2. PULL OVERDRIVE CLUTCH ASSEMBLY FROM INPUT SHAFT

CAUTION: Be careful that the thrust bearing and race do not fall out.

3. REMOVE THRUST BEARING AND RACE

Note the position of the race.

AT0479
